look_ahead.decision_instant: K = occurrence_datetime - 3 h (an estimate of kickoff; close_time is never used for timing or selection); D = the last full hour at or before K - 24 h, K - 12 h or K - 6 h; clock check: one occurrence value across the game's markets on a quarter hour and the ticker date within 2 days; live guard: a game is dropped and counted if any winner market's mid moves 0.15 or more between the candles ending at the last hour boundary at or before K and the hour before it; M2 guard: any two consecutive two-sided candles in (D, mark] moving 0.15 or more on any outcome drops the game from M2 cells only
look_ahead.features: each feature uses candles ending at or before D
look_ahead.entry_quote: the two-sided hourly candle ending in (D - 1 h, D]
look_ahead.exit: H settles on the result, read last for traded rungs; M2 sells at the bid of the hourly candle ending at the last hour boundary at or before K - 2 h

gates.unit: game (z and the BH p from game-level sums; n stated in games first)
